description: This is a shell script for testing Git configuration related to user email settings, commit author and committer identities, and rebase behaviors. It defines a series of tests to verify the enforcement and override mechanisms for email and name identities in Git commits, as well as cloning and rebasing scenarios related to email configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the provided command fails.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Configures Git user/email settings for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message for testing.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables or Git configuration variables to ensure clean test environment.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test script execution.
